steps.title: Provider plugin
steps.desc: A Service subclass; super(ctx, 'greeter') registers the instance (idea 1 & 2).

steps.title: Register on ctx
steps.desc: The registration is itself an effect, so it vanishes if the provider unloads (idea 5).

steps.title: inject waits
steps.desc: Consumer declares inject = ['greeter']; its fiber is held PENDING until the service exists (idea 3).

steps.title: Woken to apply
steps.desc: Once 'greeter' exists the fiber leaves PENDING and apply(ctx) runs with ctx.greeter ready.

steps.title: Events as effects
steps.desc: ctx.on(...) registers a typed listener that unwinds automatically on unload (idea 4 & 5).
